panel.title: Data management
panel.subtitle: Backup, restore, and export text. (For AI-parsed imports, use the «Import document» panel on the left.)

export.jsonDesc: Exports a complete backup file with all data, suitable for restoring the project.
export.jsonPrecheckNote: Before importing we check the version, project root record, and every registered table's structure; if the pre-check fails, no project data is written.
export.markdownDesc: Exports every chapter's text following the outline structure.
export.txtDesc: Ideal for publishing directly to novel platforms.
export.folderDesc: Once linked, opening this project automatically writes the full dataset to that folder (on open + every 5 minutes). The link survives refreshes/updates; after switching devices or resetting data, restore from the home page («Restore from local folder»).
export.folderBoundNeedReauth: Linked to «{{name}}», but the browser needs reauthorization for automatic writes
export.diagnosticsDesc: Includes only app/browser versions, table record counts, and error locations from this session; it does not include story text, settings, API keys, or localStorage content, and nothing is uploaded automatically.
export.successDiagnostics: Diagnostics downloaded; no story content or API keys included.
export.folderReauthSuccess: Reauthorized; this project will auto-write to this folder
export.folderSaveFailed: Write failed; please relink the folder

backup.emptyState: No snapshots yet; create the first one
backup.restoreConfirmMessage: A new project will be created; the current project will not be overwritten.

cloud.title: Cloud backup (GitHub)
cloud.subtitle: Back up to your private GitHub Gist — data lives in the cloud, <1>clearing the browser or switching devices won't lose it</1>, and it can be restored with one click.
cloud.patPlaceholder: Paste your GitHub Personal Access Token (requires gist scope)
cloud.rememberPatLabel: Remember the token on this device (write to localStorage). If unchecked, it lasts only for this browser session.
cloud.securityNote: Cloud backup uploads the full project JSON in plain text to your private Gist; private Gists are not end-to-end encrypted vaults.
cloud.connectedSecurityNote: Backup content is uploaded as full project JSON in plain text to a private GitHub Gist; the token {{storageMode}}.
cloud.storageModeRemembered: is saved in this device's localStorage
cloud.storageModeSession: is kept only in this browser session
cloud.autoBackupLabel: Auto backup (push changes to the cloud every few minutes)
cloud.lastBackupAt: Last cloud backup for this project: {{date}}
cloud.historyHeader: Project history (each backup keeps one version, newest on top · pick one to restore as a new project)
cloud.restoreConfirmMessage: A new project will be created; the current project will not be overwritten.
cloud.restoreSuccessMsg: ✓ Restored from the cloud as a new project
cloud.noRevisionsMsg: This project has no cloud revisions yet (back up once first; afterwards each backup automatically keeps a revision).
cloud.revisionRestoreConfirmMessage: A new project will be created; the current project will not be overwritten.
cloud.revisionRestoreSuccessMsg: ✓ Version from {{when}} restored as a new project
